article.headline: Kings visit Lakers Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.description: Sacramento Kings (1-13, 15th in the Western Conference) vs. Los Angeles Lakers (13-3, first in the Western Conference)
article.title: Kings visit Lakers Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.linkText: Kings visit Lakers Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.story: Sacramento Kings (1-13, 15th in the Western Conference) vs. Los Angeles Lakers (13-3, first in the Western Conference) Los Angeles; Friday, 10 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: The Los Angeles Lakers host the Sacramento Kings in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. The Lakers are 5-1 against opponents in the Pacific Division. Los Angeles is second in the Western Conference scoring 120.9 points while shooting 48.9% from the field. The Kings are 0-3 against the rest of their division. Sacramento has a 1-10 record in games decided by 10 or more points. The Lakers are shooting 48.9% from the field this season, 1.0 percentage point lower than the 49.9% the Kings allow to opponents. The Kings average 12.5 made 3-pointers per game this season, 2.6 fewer made shots on average than the 15.1 per game the Lakers give up. The teams play for the second time this season. The Lakers won the last meeting 116-103 on Nov. 5, with Luka Doncic scoring 40 points in the victory. TOP PERFORMERS: Doncic is averaging 38.1 points, seven rebounds, 7.6 assists and 1.9 steals for the Lakers. Walker Kessler is averaging 12.9 points and 11 rebounds over the last 10 games. Zach LaVine is scoring 21.2 points per game and averaging 3.4 rebounds for the Kings. Darius Acuff Jr. is averaging 28.1 points and 3.9 rebounds over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Lakers: 9-1, averaging 122.3 points, 42.8 rebounds, 25.3 assists, 11.1 steals and 5.3 blocks per game while shooting 47.8% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 115.1 points per game. Kings: 1-9, averaging 107.7 points, 39.0 rebounds, 26.5 assists, 8.3 steals and 3.8 blocks per game while shooting 46.0% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 120.2 points. INJURIES: Lakers: Austin Reaves: out (heel). Kings: Ben Simmons: out for season (achilles), Maxime Raynaud: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
